Select approved drugs (max_phase = 4) whose mechanism of action is classified as a chelating agent. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_mechanism on molregno. Filter drug_mechanism.action_type to 'CHELATING AGENT'. Join target_dictionary to retrieve target ChEMBL ID and name. Join compound_structures as an inner join to require canonical SMILES. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, and target_name. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, target_name.
